description: Defines the ApiKeyInfo class, a data model representing API key information including tenant ID, user ID, expiration, description, and status, with serialization and validation annotations.

classes.name: ApiKeyInfo
classes.description: A data class extending BaseData with tenant and user IDs, expiration, description, enabled status, and expiration check method.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the API key has expired based on current system time and expirationTime.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the API key ID, used for referencing or updating the API key.
